description: This file defines the GroupService struct with methods to manipulate groups in Mattermost, including CRUD operations, membership management, and syncable handling.

classes.name: GroupService
classes.description: A service providing methods to manipulate groups, including CRUD, membership, and syncable operations.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a group by its ID.

methods.name: GetByName
methods.description: Retrieves a group by its name.

methods.name: GetMemberUsers
methods.description: Gets a page of users from a specified group.

methods.name: GetBySource
methods.description: Gets all groups for a given source.

methods.name: ListForUser
methods.description: Lists groups a user belongs to.

methods.name: UpsertMember
methods.description: Adds or updates a user's membership in a group.

methods.name: UpsertMembers
methods.description: Adds or updates multiple users' memberships in a group.

methods.name: GetByRemoteID
methods.description: Retrieves a group by its remote ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new group.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing group.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Soft deletes a group.

methods.name: Restore
methods.description: Restores a soft-deleted group.

methods.name: DeleteMember
methods.description: Removes a user from a group.

methods.name: GetSyncable
methods.description: Gets a group syncable.

methods.name: GetSyncables
methods.description: Gets all syncables for a group.

methods.name: UpsertSyncable
methods.description: Creates or updates a group syncable.

methods.name: UpdateSyncable
methods.description: Updates a group syncable.

methods.name: DeleteSyncable
methods.description: Deletes a group syncable.

methods.name: GetGroups
methods.description: Retrieves a list of groups with options and restrictions.

methods.name: CreateDefaultSyncableMemberships
methods.description: Creates default syncable memberships based on parameters.

methods.name: DeleteGroupConstrainedMemberships
methods.description: Deletes memberships of users not in allowed groups for constrained teams and channels.
